intro: Old City & Riverfront is the historic core of Guwahati on the south bank of the Brahmaputra: Pan Bazar with its bookshops, printing presses and medicine trade, Paltan Bazaar around the main railway station, Uzan Bazar, one of the oldest settlements, with the Rajbari compound and a riverfront park, and Ulubari, where GS Road begins. Homes here tend to hide behind commerce. In Pan Bazar and Paltan Bazaar, families live in flats above or behind shops and hotels, or in older houses in the lanes; Uzan Bazar mixes houses on family plots with apartment buildings, some facing the river; and Ulubari is mostly low- and mid-rise apartment buildings.

No other zone is as easy to reach on public transport. Guwahati railway station, the busiest in the city, stands in Paltan Bazaar with the state bus terminal behind it, and buses along GS Road link Ulubari with Ganeshguri, Six Mile and Beltola. The city has no metro running, so buses, autos and shared taxis do the rest. The catch is crowding: market streets and the station area stay busy through the working day, the Ulubari stretch of GS Road is heavy in the evening peak, events at the stadiums add crowds, and riverside evenings in Uzan Bazar draw families to the park.

Because tutors from almost anywhere in Guwahati can come here by train or bus, families in the old city can afford to look for the right subject match rather than simply the nearest person. NXTutors still orders the shortlist by distance, starting with tutors who live in the old city, then those who travel here, then the rest of Guwahati, then online tutors. Each request brings two or three matched tutors with their own fees shown before you book, a free first demo, and the option to switch tutor later without paying for the change.
faqs: Why do tutors ask Pan Bazar families for a floor number?

Because many homes in Pan Bazar and Paltan Bazaar are flats above or behind shops, so the street address alone leads to a shopfront. Give the floor, the entrance to use and a nearby landmark such as the Dighalipukhuri tank or Kachari Ghat. Older houses in the lanes need a lane name more than a floor.
Is Paltan Bazaar convenient for a tutor coming by train?

Very. Guwahati railway station, the busiest in the city, is in Paltan Bazaar, with the state bus terminal at its rear. The area around it is crowded through the day, though, so agree a pick-up point or clear lane landmark, and prefer a slot after the office rush or on a weekend morning.
What should Uzan Bazar families know before booking home lessons?

That housing varies. Older independent houses on family plots let the tutor come straight to the door, while apartment buildings, some with river views, may ask visitors to sign in. The riverfront park draws crowds in the evenings, so an afternoon or early evening class is often easier to keep.
Should I choose the nearest tutor or a subject specialist in the old city?

You can often have both. NXTutors lists tutors nearest you first, but because the old city is so well served by trains and buses, a specialist from further away can usually reach you too. You see two or three matched tutors with their fees before booking, and the first class is a free demo.

intro: East of the old centre lies Chandmari & Zoo Road: Chandmari with neighbourhoods such as Milanpur, Bamunimaidam, Kannachal and Pub-Sarania, Zoo Road with Junali and Ambikagirinagar beside the state zoo, Lachit Nagar between Zoo Tiniali and South Sarania, and Bhangagarh on GS Road. Homes range from older family houses to builder floors, many of them three-bedroom, and tall apartment blocks, and a good share of flats are let to students and small households, which gives the area a young, studious feel. On Zoo Road itself flats are the norm, with floors and houses behind them in the side lanes.

Tutors move around this zone easily. Autos and buses ply Zoo Road all the way from Chandmari to Ganeshguri, VIP Road carries traffic east towards Noonmati and Narengi, Rajgarh Road connects Lachit Nagar with Chandmari, and GS Road buses bring tutors to Bhangagarh from the centre and the southern localities, while rail travellers use the main station in Paltan Bazaar. Timing is the harder part. Evening classes outside school fill children's calendars and the roads, GS Road and the medical cluster around Bhangagarh are heavy at peak hours, and some lanes in Chandmari and Lachit Nagar are narrow for parking.

Most families here want home tuition that fits around other classes, so the demo is also the moment to fix a regular weekly slot. NXTutors puts tutors from Chandmari, Zoo Road, Lachit Nagar and Bhangagarh first, then tutors who travel into the zone, then others in Guwahati, then online tutors. You get two or three matched tutors, each tutor's fee is shown on the profile before booking, and the first lesson is a free demo. If the timetable changes mid-year and the tutor can no longer fit it, switching tutor is free.
faqs: How do I fit home tuition around my child's other evening classes in Chandmari?

Fix the slot before the demo. Many students here attend evening classes, so agree a weekday time that does not clash and hold it steady week after week. A tutor living in Chandmari or on Zoo Road can usually take an earlier or later slot, since the trip is short and needs no main-road crossing.
Are Zoo Road homes mostly flats?

Along the road itself, yes. Tall apartment buildings line Zoo Road, and the lanes behind them hold builder floors and family houses. Most buildings note visitors at the entrance, so tell the guard who is coming and when. Buses and autos ply the whole road, which slows down noticeably during the evening rush.
What should a Lachit Nagar family tell a tutor who drives?

Where to park. The lanes are narrow in places, so point out a spot for a two-wheeler or car. Homes are largely builder floors and compact apartment blocks, many laid out as three-bedroom flats, so the tutor either knocks on the door or gives a name once at the entrance. GS Road and Rajgarh Road are the usual ways in.
What does a home tutor near Bhangagarh or Chandmari cost?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their own rates, and each fee is shown on the profile before the free demo class.

intro: GS Road & Dispur covers the southern sub-centre that grew around the capital complex after Dispur became the seat of government: Ganeshguri, the commercial heart where Zoo Road ends, Dispur itself with the Secretariat and Legislative Assembly, Rukminigaon just off GS Road, Hatigaon towards Survey and Bhetapara, and Kahilipara with its education department offices and institutional campuses. Flats are the main form of housing, typically of two or three bedrooms; the older lanes, particularly in Hatigaon and Kahilipara, add builder floors, family houses, plots and the occasional large villa, so arrangements differ from one lane to the next.

Ganeshguri is a crossroads for city buses coming from all sides, so tutors find this part of the south straightforward to reach, and both GS Road and the Assam Trunk Road pass through Dispur. For rail, the main station in Paltan Bazaar is closest. Many homes in Rukminigaon sit a short walk from GS Road, so a tutor on the bus has a simple last stretch. Two windows cause most delays: the start and end of the government working day near the capital complex, and the after-work surge on GS Road and at the Ganeshguri junction. Classes timed around both keep a weekly routine intact.

With so many buses crossing Ganeshguri, families on this stretch can draw tutors from the old city, the east and the far south. NXTutors lists tutors who live in Ganeshguri, Dispur, Rukminigaon, Hatigaon or Kahilipara first, then tutors who say they travel here, after them tutors elsewhere in the city, and online tutors for specialist subjects. Your request returns two or three matched tutors, with each fee visible before you book. The first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later, for example when a board-exam year begins, costs nothing.
faqs: When do roads around Dispur get busiest for a visiting tutor?

Twice a day. When government offices open and close, traffic thickens around the capital complex, and in the early evening GS Road fills with people heading home. A lesson that starts after school but outside those windows is easier to keep. Most apartment entrances want the tutor's name and your flat number, so share both before the demo.
Is Ganeshguri easy for tutors to reach?

Yes. City buses and autos converge on Ganeshguri from every side, the commercial heart of the southern sub-centre, and GS Road and Zoo Road meet here. The junction itself is heavy at peak times, so time weekday evening classes around the rush. For flats, share the building and floor; for houses, a lane landmark is enough.
How varied is housing in Kahilipara and Hatigaon?

Quite varied. In Kahilipara, apartment blocks, family houses and a few big villas sit beside large institutional compounds; Hatigaon is mainly flats of two or three bedrooms, with houses and plots on the quieter lanes. At a house the tutor simply rings the bell, while an apartment building will usually want a name in its register.
Do I have to commit to a tutor after the free demo?

No. The demo lets you judge the tutor before agreeing a schedule, and you have already seen their fee on the profile. If the fit is wrong, you can try one of the other matched tutors on your shortlist, and switching tutor later in the year is also free, whatever the reason for the change.

intro: Beltola & Khanapara is the far south of Guwahati, running from the edge of the capital complex towards the Meghalaya border. Beltola, a former small kingdom that has grown fast since the 1980s, mixes apartment buildings with traditional houses around its twice-weekly bazaar. Survey, next to Hatigaon, is mostly multistorey apartments with builder floors in quieter lanes; Six Mile has flats behind the shops and offices of GS Road; Khanapara, a regional transport hub, puts apartment buildings next to large government campuses; and Basistha, at the southern edge, has independent houses and plots as well as a large residential complex built for the 2007 National Games.

Tutors reach the far south mainly by city bus or auto, along GS Road or the national highway that curves round the southern edge of the city. The Six Mile flyover lifts traffic up to the highway, Jayanagar Road links Six Mile with its neighbours, and the highway passes through Basistha Chariali. Narangi station is an alternative rail point for the Six Mile side, with Guwahati station the main one. Market days at Beltola Bazar, regional traffic at Khanapara and evening crowds on GS Road are the times to avoid, and some Basistha lanes sit well away from the main road.

Families this far south may find that the ideal specialist lives in the north of the city, which is why NXTutors combines distance with online options. Tutors living in Beltola, Survey, Six Mile, Khanapara or Basistha are listed first, then tutors who travel south, then the rest of Guwahati, then online tutors, who can take a specialist paper while a nearby tutor covers school subjects. Each request brings two or three matched tutors with fees shown before you book, the first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later is free.
faqs: Do Beltola Bazar market days affect home lessons?

They can if you live close to it. The twice-weekly bazaar, held in the middle of Beltola since the late medieval period, brings extra traffic to the surrounding roads. Keep class times clear of market hours, or choose a tutor who lives in Beltola and can walk over. Houses allow doorstep arrival.
What does a tutor need for a large complex in Basistha?

The tower, flat number and the gate you want them to use, shared before the first class. Basistha includes a large residential complex built for the 2007 National Games, alongside independent houses and plots in quieter lanes. Some lanes are away from the main road, so a clear landmark near Basistha Chariali helps too.
Can tutors reach Six Mile and Survey easily?

Yes. City buses along GS Road serve both, and many Survey homes are a short walk from the bus stop on the main road. The Six Mile flyover links to the national highway, and Narangi station is an alternative rail point. Apartment buildings in both localities usually ask the tutor to register at the gate.
Can I combine a local tutor with an online specialist in Khanapara?

Yes. Many families pair a nearby home tutor for school subjects with an online tutor for a specialist paper. Ask for both in one request: NXTutors suggests two or three matched tutors, nearest first, with fees shown upfront, and the first class is a free demo, so you can try the arrangement first.

intro: Maligaon, Jalukbari & North Guwahati covers the city's western corridor and the far bank of the Brahmaputra. Maligaon, at the foot of the Nilachal hill, houses the regional railway headquarters and Kamakhya Junction; Adabari revolves around its three-way junction and a depot for buses to lower Assam; riverside Jalukbari is full of students, drawn by its higher-education campuses; and North Guwahati, being brought gradually into the city limits, is the site of an ancient capital with old temples. On the city bank, most families live in flats, with builder floors and some older houses mixed in. North Guwahati is more spread out, with houses, plots and fewer flats.

This is Guwahati's main rail and road gateway, so tutors in the west have good options. Kamakhya Junction, second only to the main Guwahati station in size, serves Maligaon, Adabari and Jalukbari, and city buses run through all three. Jalukbari is where the road splits for North Guwahati and for the airport side. Crossing the river is easier than it was: the two Saraighat bridges, the older one dating from 1962, have now been joined by a six-lane crossing opened in February 2026. Traffic at the Jalukbari and Adabari junctions, and the station area at Maligaon, are what to plan lesson times around.

The river still decides a lot. A family in North Guwahati is usually better served by a tutor from the north bank, and one in Adabari by a tutor from the western corridor, and NXTutors orders the list with that in mind: tutors living in this zone first, then those who travel here, then others in Guwahati, then online tutors for subjects with fewer local teachers. You get two or three matched tutors and see every tutor's fee before booking. The first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later carries no charge.
faqs: Has the new bridge made North Guwahati easier for tutors?

Somewhat. The six-lane bridge that opened in February 2026 links the city directly with North Guwahati, alongside the two Saraighat bridges. Coming from the city side remains a lengthy trip, though, so a tutor living on the north bank is usually more practical, and online lessons can cover a specialist subject.
How do tutors reach Maligaon and Adabari?

By train or bus. Kamakhya Junction stands in Maligaon, and city buses stop at Adabari Tiniali, the three-way junction at the edge of Kamakhya Nagar. Because the junction and the depot for lower-Assam buses are crowded all day, fix an exact meeting spot or lane landmark for the tutor's first visit.
Does Durga Puja affect lessons in Maligaon?

It can. Maligaon celebrates Durga Puja in a big way, and the roads near the station are busy during the festival. On those evenings, move the lesson online or earlier in the day. Apartment buildings in Maligaon may also want visitors to write their name at the entrance, so share the tutor's name in advance.
Will I only see tutors from my bank of the river?

Not only, but they come first. NXTutors lists tutors living in this zone before those who travel here, then tutors from elsewhere in the city, with online tutors last. From your two or three matched tutors you compare fees on the profiles, pick one, and take a free first demo before agreeing regular lessons.
